author: Animalogic
description:
Thanks to the support of generous animal lovers like you, ACE met their $300,000 goal. But if you still want to help, we have great news. If you start a monthly donation to the Movement Grants program this week, your first gift will be matched - up to a total of $10,000. And the animals will thank you! https://animalcharityevaluators.org/animalogic/

Today we crown the greatest cat on Earth. This is the season of our miniseries where pitted all cats against each other and tested their hunting prowess, physical skills, brainpower, sociability, and special tools to figure out once and for all who the best cat in the world is. Watch along and see the dark horse (dark cat?) of the tournament go home with the crown of King of Cats!

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
